product_overview: A backend API for Abou-Taleb Education that supports multilingual public experiences, secure client authentication, enrollment/order submission, and an admin workflow for managing orders. The system emphasizes safe error handling, role-based access, and stateful order processing with auditability.
core_goals: Provide secure client registration, verification, login, session restore, logout, and password reset flows
Allow verified clients to create and manage only their own enrollment orders
Enable admins to inspect, assign, transition, and annotate orders with full workflow visibility
Expose reliable health/readiness endpoints and structured error responses for operational monitoring
Preserve safe handling of sensitive data, CSRF protection, and role-based access control

features.name: Health and readiness
features.description: Public endpoints that let operators and automated checks verify the API is alive and ready to serve traffic.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/health -> Receive 200 with service status ok for api -> GET /api/v1/health/readiness -> Receive 200 with readiness checks and status
GET /api/v1/health/readiness when database or dependencies are unavailable -> Receive 200 or readiness failure details indicating not ready
GET /api/v1/health with no authentication -> Receive 200 without requiring cookies or tokens

features.name: Authentication and sessions
features.description: Client registration, email verification, login, session restoration, logout, and password reset with safe errors and CSRF protection.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/register with fullName, email, password, consentAccepted true -> Receive 201 with public user and verification message -> POST /api/v1/auth/verify-email with email and valid six-digit code -> Receive 200 with verified public user -> POST /api/v1/auth/login with verified credentials -> Receive 200 with public user and session/CSRF cookies -> GET /api/v1/auth/session with session cookie -> Receive 200 with public user
POST /api/v1/auth/register with an email that already exists -> Receive 409 with ACCOUNT_EXISTS safe error
POST /api/v1/auth/verify-email with expired, exhausted, consumed, or invalid six-digit code -> Receive 400 with INVALID_VERIFICATION
POST /api/v1/auth/login with invalid password or unverified account -> Receive 401 INVALID_LOGIN or 403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED safely without exposing account details
POST /api/v1/auth/logout with authenticated session and valid X-CSRF-Token -> Receive 204 no content and session revoked -> GET /api/v1/auth/session -> Receive 401 UNAUTHENTICATED after logout

POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password with email -> Receive 200 generic safe message -> POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password with email, valid reset OTP, and newPassword -> Receive 200 success message and all existing sessions revoked
POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password with invalid reset OTP -> Receive 400 INVALID_RESET and no password change

features.name: Client order workflow
features.description: Verified clients can create enrollment orders, list their own orders, read order details, submit responses in allowed states, and cancel when the workflow allows it.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/orders with authenticated verified client, X-CSRF-Token, fullName, phoneNumber, specialization -> Receive 201 with order reference and history -> GET /api/v1/orders -> Receive 200 with owned orders -> GET /api/v1/orders/:orderId -> Receive 200 with the owned order details
POST /api/v1/orders with signed-out or unverified client -> Receive 403 indicating unverified or non-client access is blocked
GET /api/v1/orders/:orderId for an order not owned by the authenticated client -> Receive 404 not found or not owned

POST /api/v1/orders/:orderId/responses with authenticated client, X-CSRF-Token, and response body while in allowed waiting state -> Receive 201 response receipt -> POST /api/v1/orders/:orderId/responses again for the same order -> Receive 409 invalid state or duplicate response

POST /api/v1/orders/:orderId/cancel with authenticated client and X-CSRF-Token when the state machine allows cancellation -> Receive 204 no content -> POST /api/v1/orders/:orderId/cancel again or from a terminal state -> Receive 409 invalid transition

features.name: Admin order management
features.description: Admin-only endpoints for monitoring, searching, inspecting, assigning, transitioning, and annotating orders across the workflow.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/admin/orders/metrics with admin authentication -> Receive 200 with status counts and total -> GET /api/v1/admin/orders with admin authentication and query filters for status, specialization, search, sort, order, page, and pageSize -> Receive 200 with paginated orders
GET /api/v1/admin/orders/:orderId with admin authentication -> Receive 200 with full order detail including timeline, responses, assignment, and internal notes

PATCH /api/v1/admin/orders/:orderId/assignment with admin authentication, X-CSRF-Token, and assignedAdminId for an active admin -> Receive 200 with assignment details -> PATCH /api/v1/admin/orders/:orderId/assignment with invalid assignment data -> Receive 400 INVALID_ASSIGNMENT

POST /api/v1/admin/orders/:orderId/status with admin authentication, X-CSRF-Token, to status, and optional clientVisibleMessage -> Receive 200 with transition receipt and status history update -> POST /api/v1/admin/orders/:orderId/status with an illegal transition or attempt to reopen a terminal order -> Receive 409 INVALID_ORDER_TRANSITION
POST /api/v1/admin/orders/:orderId/internal-notes with admin authentication, X-CSRF-Token, and body -> Receive 201 with internal note stored privately
GET /api/v1/admin/orders/metrics as a non-admin user -> Receive 403 FORBIDDEN

features.name: Security and error handling
features.description: Cross-cutting protections for CSRF, role authorization, request tracing, and structured safe errors across the API.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/orders or GET /api/v1/admin/orders without valid authentication where required -> Receive 401 or 403 structured error object with safe message and requestId
POST /api/v1/orders/:orderId/cancel or POST /api/v1/admin/orders/:orderId/status with missing or mismatched X-CSRF-Token -> Receive 403 INVALID_CSRF error object with requestId
ANY /api/v1/* endpoint returning an internal failure -> Receive 500 INTERNAL_ERROR without sensitive details and with requestId
Access an admin endpoint using a non-admin session -> Receive 403 FORBIDDEN with structured error response
Trigger validation or workflow errors on protected endpoints -> Receive 4xx error object with code, safe message, and requestId without leaking passwords, tokens, or OTPs
